name: Dread Sense (Su)
body:
Prerequisite: Nightblade 12, Path of the Bloodied Chain

Benefit: The nightblade gains the ability to detect scared creatures simply by being near them, even if she cannot see them. She gains blindsight out to 60 feet, but it only allows her to perceive creatures that are suffering from a fear effect.
